declarations.description:
A complete multi-step questionnaire with single- and multiple-choice questions, optional free-text answers,
validation, keyboard shortcuts and previous / skip / next navigation. Questions are supplied as an array through
the `questions` property or as JSON in the `questions` attribute. The component preserves answers between steps,
emits progress events and submits the complete answer object as JSON when given a form `name`.
declarations.name: Questionnaire

members.name: questions
members.description: Questionnaire definition. Use `select` for one answer and `choice` for multiple answers (`single` / `multiple` remain aliases). May also be supplied as JSON.

members.name: questionItemRender
members.description: Optional renderer for each option's content. Assign this as a JavaScript property; functions cannot be passed through HTML attributes.

members.name: answers
members.description: Current answers keyed by question id.

members.name: completed
members.description: Shows the answer summary after successful completion.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. Its submitted value is the answer object serialized as JSON.

members.name: nextLabel
members.description: Label of the forward action before the final question.

members.name: completeLabel
members.description: Label of the forward action on the final question.

members.name: next
members.description: Move to the next question, or complete the questionnaire on the final question. Returns whether validation passed.

members.name: skip
members.description: Skip the current question when it is marked `skippable`.

members.name: reset
members.description: Clear all answers and return to the first question.

events.name: complete
events.description: Fired from Next / Save on the last valid question.

events.name: skip
events.description: Fired when a skippable question is skipped.

events.name: step-change
events.description: Fired after navigation changes the visible question.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ questionId: string, value: QuestionnaireAnswer, answers: QuestionnaireAnswers }>
